frame: LVLH (x=radial, y=along-track, z=cross-track), chief at origin
purpose: Stress-test the LEARNED V level set. At these starts the min dv reaching the KOZ within 1800 s is ~0.02-0.05 m/s (<< 0.5 cap), so V-bound unsafe cases are NOT also dv-cap cases.
relabel_warning: Labels use a free-drift KOZ-reachability PROXY for V<=0. For the BRT claim, relabel with the trained network (--brt-checkpoint-dir) by replacing v_value().

label_criteria.passive_preburn_unsafe: pre-burn free drift reaches KOZ within 1800s
label_criteria.binding_constraint: v_bound | dv_bound | v_and_dv | none -- the report row key

ablation: On this corpus, run the filter with passive checks OFF (FILTER_CHECK_PASSIVE_POST=0 FILTER_CHECK_PASSIVE_PRE=0) to isolate pure V-based filtering; the 'v_bound' plans are the ones that should still be intercepted.
